import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Digital Camera Specifications Analysis (n=1000)', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(sensor_types))
for sensor, color in zip(sensor_types, colors):
    mask = df['sensor_type'] == sensor
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['megapixels'], df[mask]['price_usd'], 
                alpha=0.6, label=sensor, c=[color], s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Sensor Type', loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Average Price by Brand (Top 10 brands)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
brand_avg_price = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
top_brands = brand_avg_price.tail(10)
bars = ax2.barh(top_brands.index, top_brands.values, color=sns.color_palette('viridis', 10))
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Brand', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Top 10 Brands by Average Price', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')
for bar, val in zip(bars, top_brands.values):
    ax2.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Distribution of Cameras by Body Type and 4K Video Capability
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
body_4k = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
body_4k.columns = ['No 4K', 'Has 4K']
body_4k.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=['#ff7f0e', '#1f77b4'], edgecolor='black', width=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Camera Count by Body Type and 4K Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='4K Video', fontsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Plot 4: Weight vs Price with Model Year as color
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
scatter = ax4.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], cmap='plasma', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Price vs Weight (Colored by Model Year)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
